'''Plethyl nitrate''' was a type of medical drug that has a different effect on numerous [[Species/Legends|species]]. When administered to a [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronian]], it could cure lobar [[pneumonia]]. To a [[Human/Legends|Human]], it would drop his [[Blood/Legends|blood]] pressure into the syncope zone. For a [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]], two ccs would be enough to [[Death/Legends|kill]].<ref name="MedStar II: Jedi Healer">''[[MedStar II: Jedi Healer]]''</ref>
